harness: OUTBOUND_GUARD_CLIENT_REBIND=1 python3 tools/client_cancellation_probe.py CLIENT EXTRACTED_BINARY ATTESTED_SKILL_ZIP

fixture.namespace: disposable route-free Linux network namespace for the MCP child
fixture.public_policy_address: 11.0.0.1 is locally assigned only in the namespace

checks: first rebind.test GET succeeded through the public-policy fixture address
second rebind.test GET resolved again and denied the loopback answer
exactly two A queries for rebind.test
HTTP saw only approved control and first rebinding request
limits: The fixture-hit oracle does not prove no forbidden socket syscall or packet was emitted; separate network trace probes cover that narrower property outside these native-client runs.

This tests one host changing its A answer between separate guarded calls. It does not test intra-call resolver changes, DNS cache implementations, all A/AAAA combinations or every reconnect path through native clients.
Only explicit skill invocation and this ordered call sequence are covered. Malformed protocol, resource exhaustion, native UI controls and traffic sent through other tools remain separate gates.
The client authentication ran on the host with existing accounts. No credentials or raw transcripts are retained. The Debian installer is unsigned, with signed build provenance.
